SELECT count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_lineid, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_receipt_line, sum(quantity) AS units, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff, sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wb
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

calls.statement: SELECT business_date, receipts, units_sold, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, count(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS versions, count(DISTINCT p.product_name) AS names, sum(f.quantity) AS units, count(*) AS lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY units DESC, p.sku LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
SELECT p.sku, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS returned_units
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.sku IN (101624,101778,102244,102233,103670)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
